about: Single source for AISOP editions (docs/166_EDITIONS_AND_TIERS_SOP.md). Membership: a Markdown document is in every edition whose tier is >= its header 'tier'; other files join through 'include' globs, inherited by higher editions. Budgets are bytes; the audit warns at warn_fraction and fails at 100%.

editions.name: card
editions.title: Card
editions.audience: Any chat product, including free plans and custom-instruction boxes.

editions.name: chatkit
editions.title: Chat Kit
editions.audience: Chat-only plans with file upload but no filesystem or shell; beginners.

editions.name: method
editions.title: Method Kit
editions.audience: Agentic tools with a filesystem (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot agents, Gemini CLI); practitioners who want the full method and audit tooling without the domain guides.
editions.delivery: <package_id>_method.zip, or a clone with tier-3 files ignored
editions.budget_note: Raised from 409,600 to 524,288 bytes in REV-003 Phase 2 under DECISION-014 (the Phase 2 dry build measured 473,970 bytes, 116% of the old budget); see CHANGELOG.

editions.name: full
editions.title: Full
editions.audience: Maintainers, contributors, and projects that need the domain guides.

openers.card: Use the AISOP card above as your operating rules. Reply with the AISOP version it names and the word ORIENT, then ask me for my idea.
openers.chatkit: I have uploaded the AISOP Chat Kit. Read EDITION_INFO.md, then README_START_HERE.md, then the card. Work in ORIENT or APPLY mode only and never ask for a file that EDITION_INFO.md does not list. Reply with: the AISOP version and package_id, the files you can see, the word ORIENT, and the question 'what is your idea?'.
openers.method: Read AGENTS.md and follow its first-five-minutes protocol.
openers.full: Read AGENTS.md and follow its first-five-minutes protocol.

commands: every audit; prints the SUMMARY block (drop --quiet for full output)
generated files fresh, edition budgets, links inside each edition
regenerate every generated file and region (then rerun the audits)
release naming check without writing a zip

link_check.about: Write a downstream project's own paths as ./tools/x.py so they are not read as AISOP paths. Planning records describe proposed paths and are not link-checked; history records are checked in the full tree only.
